comments.author: Kirito-Kun
comments.body: Look's like a Good Adventurer Aide.

comments.author: Curious
comments.body: Good if you do a lot of piracy/privateering too. There are better adventure aides than this, if you do adventure primarily.

comments.author: DiNozzo
comments.body:
I cannot see any point in hiring adventure aides for discovery-related skills.
If you are to hire an aide for adventure, I recommend Holfina who has wind, wave and seaweed proofness. She is the best figurehead indeed lol

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: You'd be surprised how often those skill boosts come in handy when adventuring. That said, it's situational: some folks will find it useful to have a little extra Theology or the ability to correspond with three nations, some would prefer Holfina's sailing combos. That's the beauty of a game like UWO.
